correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives \(d(w-x/a)/dt=0\). The affine coordinate change makes the invariant three-dimensional tangent bundle and identity quotient explicit. With \(\varepsilon>0\) the vector field has no equilibria, so the flow direction contributes a zero exponent on compact support; the quotient contributes a second zero exponent. Invariance of \(z\) gives \(\int y^2\,d\mu=\varepsilon\). The negative-sum implication is then a four-exponent counting argument. The bundled symbolic checker independently replays the algebraic identities and source initial-condition values.

value.rationale: The first integral removes one effective state dimension exactly and imposes a second neutral Lyapunov direction beyond ordinary flow neutrality. This directly constrains interpretation of a published four-dimensional hyperchaos claim, identifies a reproducible structural diagnostic for its finite-time spectra, and shows that two source trajectories presented as dynamically different actually share the same invariant leaf. The result is not a cosmetic algebraic simplification: it changes the admissible asymptotic Lyapunov signatures of dissipative invariant measures.
